qualification.details: Junior Research Assistant (JRA): M.Sc. (Ag.), M.Sc., M. Pharm., M.V.Sc., Bachelor of Engineering/Technology (B.E./B.Tech.) or equivalent degree. High academic attainment with 1st class in graduate and post graduate examination. Senior Research Assistant (SRA): M.Sc., M.Sc. (Ag.), M. Pharm., M.V.Sc. or equivalent degree with high academic attainment and at least two years research experience after M.Sc. etc., as evident from the published papers in reputed Journals, or 1st class M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent degree or 1st class M.B.B.S. (with completed internship in medicine). Research Associate (RA): Ph.D. or equivalent degree or M.Tech., M.E., M.D. with three years' research, design and development experience. | Candidates having relevant experience in areas such as heat and mass transfer, adsorption, atmospheric water harvesting, carbon capture, thermal systems, experimental research, instrumentation, IoT-based systems, or related areas will be preferred.

salary_details.details: Consolidated fellowship of Rs. 28,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MNNIT Allahabad JRA/SRA/RA posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 19th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authorities before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for these positions?
faq.answer: The required qualifications include B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. in relevant engineering disciplines. Specific details for JRA, SRA, and RA are provided in the eligibility criteria section.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for JRA/SRA/RA positions?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated fellowship of Rs. 28,000/- per month for the duration of the project.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the MNNIT Allahabad JRA/SRA/RA recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the specified addresses. Ensure you follow the application procedure outlined in the notification and this article.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the JRA/SRA/RA posts?
faq.answer: The age limits are 28 years for JRA, 32 years for SRA, and 35 years for RA as of April 1, 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the available information, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these contract positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on their merit, qualifications, and experience, followed by a walk-in interview for those who are shortlisted.

faq.question: Q8. Which departments are involved in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for positions within the Mechanical Engineering department, as indicated by the advertisement number and the nature of the research field.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These are project-based positions, meaning they are temporary and tied to the duration of the specific research project for which the recruitment is being conducted.
